name: Karmarts Public Company Limited
summary: Karmarts Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, packaging, import, and distribution of cosmetics and consumer products in Thailand. The company operates in four segments: Manufacture and Distribution of Consumer Products; Warehouse for Rental; Investment Properties and Distribution of By-Products and Agriculture; and Real Estate Development. It offers facial care and cleanser, body care and cleanser, makeup, beauty accessories, body fragrance, hair care, nutrition and detox supplements, skin-enhancing supplements, scented, oral care, acne and sensitive skin care, alcohol-based hand sanitizers, face masks, facial skincare, hair coloring, dishwash…
